data.title: As Israel faces political deadlock, Benjamin Netanyahu may be able to renew Iran strikes | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: If Eisenkot had won the battle of the blocs and, in a head-to-head with Netanyahu, as the polls forecast, he might have been able to start forming a government before the US midterm elections.
